Container.Name: sofa-king
Container.Overview: Self-hosted media center server: live TV from free streaming services, tuners and M3U/XMLTV playlists in one lineup, a DVR with commercial detection, and movie and TV libraries, for the Sofa King app on Android TV, phones, desktops, iOS, Apple TV and the web. It also serves the lineup to Plex as an HDHomeRun tuner. The admin token is adminToken in secrets.json in the config folder.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: The database, the logo cache, the generated tokens, and sources.json and policy.json when you add them.

Config.Name: Recordings
Config.Description: Where the DVR writes recordings, in the layout Plex, Jellyfin and Emby scan.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Your movies and shows, read only, for the media libraries.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: The port the server listens on, on the host's network.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: The container's time zone, such as America/Chicago.

Config.Name: Hardware acceleration
Config.Description: auto uses the first GPU encoder that works once /dev/dri is passed through, else the CPU.

Config.Name: GPU
Config.Description: An Intel or AMD GPU for converting library files: set it to /dev/dri and add --group-add with the render group's id to Extra Parameters.
